name: mkv-cleaner
description: Cleans MKV and M4V files by remuxing them with mkvmerge: keeps the best audio track in your language, drops commentary and foreign tracks, strips attachments and metadata junk, renames the output.

interface.longDescription: Probes every file, keeps the highest quality audio track in the target language plus its subtitles and chapters, drops everything else, and remuxes into a cleaned/ folder with a per-file report. No re-encoding.
defaultPrompt: Clean all MKVs and M4Vs in ~/Movies recursively
Clean all MKVs here but keep French audio too
